steps.c: Mark board A at 80, 96 and 112 cm.
Saw board A into an 80 cm base and two 16 cm ends.
Saw boards B and C each to 80 cm.
Drive 8 screws, 70 mm long, up through the base into the sides.
Drive 16 screws, 70 mm long, through the sides into the ends.
